title: Pathway component presence/absence across the DELPHI flight/gliding species panel, by orthology
question: Is a pathway our genes sit in intact in gliders and incomplete elsewhere, or the same everywhere?
bird_exclusion: Class Aves is this project's frozen holdout: no bird genome was queried and no bird species is in the panel, until the holdout exam runs.

pathways_dropped.GO:0033339: pectoral fin development, 40 member genes: over the per-pathway cap of 36 set for this run; GO:0035138 pectoral fin morphogenesis (9 genes) and GO:0033334 fin morphogenesis (15) cover the same question

go_bp.aspect: biological process (P) only; NOT-qualified annotations dropped
go_bp.note: GO is a process ontology, not a pathway database. Evidence code is kept on every entry; computational codes are flagged.

reactome.species_filter: Danio rerio rows only (Oryzias latipes rows in this file: 0)
reactome.note: Reactome documentation, 'Inferred events': "we use curated human reactions to electronically infer reactions in fourteen evolutionarily divergent eukaryotic species"; homology comes from PANTHER. Every Danio rerio row in Ensembl2Reactome.txt carries evidence code IEA, and the ContentService reports isInferred: true for a Danio rerio pathway (checked on R-DRE-8866652).

kegg.note: KEGG gene ids for dre are NCBI GeneIDs, joined to ZFIN ids through ZFIN's gene.txt. Free for academic use; four calls made.

identifier_joins.zfin_ensembl_1_to_1: C:/Temp/genotype/raw/ensembl_1_to_1.txt (already in the thread's raw set)

inputs.carried_caveat: Every Reactome zebrafish row in genotype/pathways.json is inferred_by_orthology = 1, as that file records. So for Reactome pathways this analysis compares orthology against orthology, and the zebrafish membership itself is not experimental.

method.orthology: Ensembl REST: /xrefs/symbol/danio_rerio/{symbol} for the gene id, then /homology/id/danio_rerio/{id}?type=orthologues&format=condensed for every orthologue Ensembl Compara holds. A species counts as PRESENT when Compara returns at least one orthologue in it.
method.query_species: Every member gene is a ZEBRAFISH gene from genotype/pathways.json, so zebrafish is the query species and is marked present by construction. Ensembl Compara does not list a gene as its own orthologue; a first version of this table therefore read 0/N for zebrafish in every pathway, which was an artefact, not a finding.
method.do_not_over_read: An orthologue missing from Compara is NOT evidence the gene is missing from the animal. Three different things produce the same blank: (1) the species has no genome in Ensembl at all, (2) it has a genome but the gene is not annotated or not placed in a Compara tree, (3) the gene is really absent. Only (3) is biology, and this method cannot tell them apart. Rows are therefore split into no_genome and genome_but_no_orthologue.
